draft_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieved a higher mean BLEU than Varrow-NMT (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieved a higher mean BLEU than Varrow-NMT (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds), a statistically significant difference (paired t-test, t=3.13, df=7, p=0.017, 95% CI [0.2, 1.44]).
rationale: The sentence's factual claim (28.4 vs 27.6) is fully supported by T1.r1.bleu and T1.r2.bleu. The package also reports a significant paired t-test (S2) for exactly this comparison, which the sentence omits; the evidence supports a stronger, significance-qualified claim.
